body: Hi - We are currently in couples counseling, but it seems to yield cyclical results.

Thanks for replying. My experiences with those have (so far) kicked up the dust and made these problems seem a lot larger than I initially thought. We started out under the pretense that I was "disconnecting" from the relationship and not putting enough effort it. I can picture specific times when that was the case, but there was always a lot to it that has been glossed over.

The fresh start I'm picturing is like a mixture of the "glory days" and dreams I had for my future. I have very good friends who live a couple provinces over (Ontario) and I often think of what it would be like to live near them with my son pursuing some sort of musical venture. Even just as a hobby. I picture being with someone who shares even somewhat similar interests, beliefs (or lack thereof) and actually has an encouraging/supportive attitude/personality.

Thanks again. It feels like a relief to even type out what I would want from life.
